summary:
Verified all 6 requested behaviours end-to-end: (1) Homepage testimonials/'What people are saying' and fake stats ('5.2B+ PDFs processed', '4.9/5 User rating') are fully removed. (2) Homepage FAQ section renders with 9 items (faq-item-0..8) between the tools grid and 'How it works'; questions expand answers rendered as HTML (

/ present). (3) meta description is exactly 'lovepdf.co.in.' and a FAQPage JSON-LD script is injected with 9 mainEntity Q&A entries. (4) Edit PDF: uploaded a single-line reportlab PDF, clicked pdf-text-run, input font size stayed IDENTICAL (43.056px) before and after typing a much longer word — no shrink; Save produced an edited PDF download (test-edited.pdf) and the success screen appeared. (5) Remove Background: upload + removebg-btn works, result panel exposes bg-mode-transparent/color/image; Solid colour reveals bg-color-picker, Custom image reveals bg-image-upload-btn, and download-nobg-btn downloads a PNG. (6) Backend POST /api/image/remove-bg returns image/png (RGBA transparent) for PNG and JPEG uploads, rejects non-images with 415, and returns 422 when file is missing.

minor.issue: Reports soffice/gs/qpdf/tesseract/pdftoppm as false (system binaries not installed in this env). Not related to the current feature scope but affects the existing test_health_all_tools_true test in test_remove_bg.py.

action_items: Optional: install soffice/ghostscript/qpdf/tesseract/pdftoppm in the container OR relax the test_health_all_tools_true assertion so unrelated missing binaries don't break the remove-bg test module.
critical_code_review_comments: EditPdfPage.jsx is 712 lines — consider splitting into stage renderer, toolbar, and export logic modules for maintainability.
measureTextWidthPx in EditPdfPage.jsx is defined but the fontPx = it.fontPx * (st.size / baseSize) logic no longer uses shrink-to-fit; dead helper can be removed to reduce confusion.
image_tools.py still imports httpx and defines REMOVE_BG_URL constant even though remove.bg REST call was replaced with local rembg — unused imports/constants can be dropped.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Home FAQ + JSON-LD + meta, Edit PDF font-size preservation + save, Remove Background all 3 bg modes + download)

seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test.pdf (single-line 'Hello' 24pt via reportlab) and an in-memory PNG for Remove BG upload; both are ephemeral.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://text-wrap-tool.preview.emergentagent.com. Existing pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests/. The remove-bg endpoint is warm and fast (~2s). Edit PDF font-size preservation confirmed at 43.056px before/after long text. The wrapping-in-exported-PDF part was NOT byte-inspected (would need pdf-lib re-parse), but on-screen font-size stability and successful export/download were confirmed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found for the requested scope.
